title: Autonomous Dynamic Speculative Decoding & Draft Model Offloading via Apple MLX
target_platform: Apple Silicon M1 (16GB Unified Memory) via Apple MLX
hypothesis: Deploying 1.5B/3B lightweight draft models alongside 7B Qwen2.5-Coder via MLX speculative decoding (--draft-model and --num-draft-tokens) will increase generation throughput by >= 1.6x on Apple Silicon unified memory while remaining safely within the 8 GiB memory budget.
falsification_criteria: Draft model acceptance rate falls below 50% or combined unified memory footprint causes macOS swap pressure > 1 GiB.

model_routing.frontier_escalation_condition: Escalate to frontier model only if local speculative decoding encounters memory pressure

evidence.details: Held-out 10 prompts, frozen config 1.5B draft k=2 (selected on dev): median speedup 1.40x (min 1.30x) < 1.6x; peak 4.99 GiB <= 8 GiB; 10/10 outputs identical. Dev: 3B drafts 1.05-1.15x. Frozen 1e43214ab.

lessons_learned: On an M1 16GB, a Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B draft with k=2 speeds up 7B-4bit greedy generation about 1.4x (14.1 to 19.7 tok/s), losslessly, for +0.8 GiB; not 1.6x.
Bigger drafts and larger k raised acceptance but lowered throughput: 3B gave only 1.05-1.15x.

projected_impact.basis: Declared 2026-11-04 by claude-code (MISSION-031 backfill) from the mission's hypothesis; a mission always also edits its own manifest. Refine at checkout and confirm with `manage_coordination.py verify`.

experiment: Dev sweep (3 prompts) over draft {1.5B,3B} x num_draft_tokens {2,4}; select one config; freeze; held-out 10 prompts baseline vs selected config. Greedy, 256 tokens, mlx-lm 0.32.2. See LEARNING/experiments/mission-023/protocol.md.
score_basis: Not recorded at registration (2026-11-03); priority 200 is the formula (5x4)/(0.05x2). Cost weight 0.05 reflected local-only compute; actual cost also included orchestration tokens and ~2.6 GB of draft-model downloads.

readiness.assessment: Executed 2026-11-08 by claude-code orchestrating local MLX models.

related_missions.MISSION-019: SIBLING (shared resource): the MLX server lifecycle controller; this benchmark stopped and restarted that server.
related_missions.MISSION-003: EXTENDS: builds on native Apple Silicon MLX local inference.
